national; EMIS officers cover district clusters

note: No fact: the Termly School Report is stated to collect aggregated data per school each term (enrolment, attendance, feeding, WASH), not a record per learner, so it is classed census although it is termly; the brief describes the national EMIS only as collecting and aggregating enrolment, teacher and infrastructure data, and mentions 'individual-level data' once without saying who enters it. Parent to settle the TSR's class: it is entered between census days but holds counts.
